versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the workbuddy-data-migration skill.
- Enables seamless migration of the WorkBuddy data directory off the system drive to a fixed non-system disk using a Windows directory junction.
- Ensures all data—including conversation history, sessions, skills, logs, Python/Node runtimes, and caches—move from C: to the target drive and remain there permanently.
- Employs a bundled batch and Node.js script for safe, verified migration without breaking absolute paths or requiring config changes.
- Includes read-only inventory, optional safe cleanup, data migration with verification, and robust handling of common Windows environment issues.
- Provides detailed troubleshooting resources for custom or trimmed Windows images.
